gui.itemexplorer.title: Item Explorer
message.itemexplorer.storage_locked: Storage data could not be loaded safely. Transfers are disabled; original data is preserved. Ask the server owner to check the log and recovery backup.
gui.itemexplorer.choose_target: Click a destination folder or breadcrumb. Esc cancels.
gui.itemexplorer.withdraw_hint: Take the entered quantity. Right-click an item for 1, or Shift-click for 64.
gui.itemexplorer.move_hint: Move the entered quantity to a folder. You can also drag an item onto a folder.
gui.itemexplorer.all_hint: Set the quantity to the selected entry's full amount.
gui.itemexplorer.deposit_hint: Deposit the carried stack. Shift-click an inventory stack to deposit directly.
message.itemexplorer.full: Storage full or nothing to deposit
message.itemexplorer.inventory_full: Inventory full or quantity is zero
message.itemexplorer.invalid_name: Use 1–24 characters; no slashes or control characters
message.itemexplorer.duplicate_name: A folder with this name already exists
message.itemexplorer.root_folder: Cannot rename or delete the main drive
message.itemexplorer.not_empty: Only empty folders can be deleted
message.itemexplorer.folder_limit: This drive reached its folder limit or 8-level depth limit.
message.itemexplorer.entry_limit: This drive reached its item entry limit.
message.itemexplorer.nested_device: Terminals, NAS devices and disks cannot be stored in a drive.
message.itemexplorer.item_too_large: This item's extra data is too large
message.itemexplorer.missing_item: Item moved or removed. Select again.
gui.itemexplorer.install_hint: Carry a disk and click Insert, or Shift-click a disk in your inventory.
gui.itemexplorer.eject_hint: Eject to your inventory. Requires one empty slot.
disk.itemexplorer.blank: Initialized on first insertion. Choose your own name and use.
disk.itemexplorer.portable: Data belongs to this world. Portable within the same save.
message.itemexplorer.disk_missing: Disk data is missing. Check the original world and backups.
message.itemexplorer.disk_mismatch: Disk tier does not match world data. Mount refused.
message.itemexplorer.disk_conflict: This disk is already mounted in another bay.
message.itemexplorer.disk_offline: Disk offline. Check the cables and drive bay, or select another disk.
message.itemexplorer.disk_only: A bay accepts one storage disk.
message.itemexplorer.nas_full: All four bays are occupied. Eject a disk first.
message.itemexplorer.cross_disk: To move between drives, take items into your inventory first.
gui.itemexplorer.port_recursive_hint: Read / extract from subfolders. Incoming items always go into the selected folder.
message.itemexplorer.port_unconfigured: Choose a drive and folder, then apply.
message.itemexplorer.port_disabled: Connected; input and output are disabled.
message.itemexplorer.port_full: Drive full. Extraction is still available if enabled.
gui.itemexplorer.search_hint: Search items in the current drive. Ctrl+F focuses search.
gui.itemexplorer.search_drive_hint: Search all folders in the current drive. Click to use the starting folder and its subfolders.
gui.itemexplorer.search_tree_hint: Search the starting folder and its subfolders. Click to use the entire current drive.
gui.itemexplorer.search_exit_hint: Exit search and restore the previous folder and page. Esc also exits.
gui.itemexplorer.search_result_hint: Double-click to locate. Right-click to take 1; Shift-click to take 64.
gui.itemexplorer.search_matching_hint: Search names in the current language, custom names or registry IDs. Every space-separated term must match. @mekanism filters the mod. An empty query shows all items in scope.
gui.itemexplorer.locate_hint: Exit search and open the selected item's folder and page. You can also double-click a search result.
gui.itemexplorer.search_deposit_hint: Depositing and moving are paused during search. Locate an item or exit search first.
message.itemexplorer.search_active: Locate a folder or exit search before depositing, moving or changing folders.
gui.itemexplorer.station_ready_hint: The green light indicates a complete structure. Wire the rear port to any terminal face. Local wired access only; remote transfers are not available yet.
gui.itemexplorer.station_front_hint: Top view, bottom to top. Front is below.
gui.itemexplorer.station_legend_base: F: casing  C: controller  P: network port  B: module
gui.itemexplorer.station_legend_tower: M: mast  A: antenna panel  T: cap
gui.itemexplorer.station_rotation_hint: Sneak + empty-hand right-click to rotate a panel. Place the controller facing you.
gui.itemexplorer.cable_unloaded: Station: cable or station area unloaded
gui.itemexplorer.cable_terminal_hint: Wire any terminal/NAS face; use the station rear port.
gui.itemexplorer.cable_local_only: NAS drives work over local cables; wireless transfers are not available yet.
gui.itemexplorer.local_wire_unloaded: Local cable: area unloaded; wired NAS access paused
gui.itemexplorer.local_wire_too_large: Local cable: exceeds 256 cables; wired NAS access paused
gui.itemexplorer.production_count_hint: Run 1–4096 times, consuming one input item per run. Set a new count whenever you start this program.
gui.itemexplorer.production_cancel_hint: Stop this program. Items already inside the machine remain there.
gui.itemexplorer.production_choose_input: No smeltable item in this folder
gui.itemexplorer.production_cycle_hint: Click to cycle; Shift-click to go back. Only this folder is used.
gui.itemexplorer.production_start_hint: Execute this program on the selected machine for the entered number of runs.
gui.itemexplorer.production_dedicated_hi: Attach a port to a dedicated furnace, blast furnace, smoker or brewing stand, and connect it by data cable to one terminal. Programs run from the terminal's local folders.
gui.itemexplorer.production_ready_hint: Enter a run count and start with an empty machine.
gui.itemexplorer.production_running_hint: Running; cancellation is available. Do not modify the machine manually.
message.itemexplorer.production_stale: The program or connection changed. Try again.
message.itemexplorer.production_invalid: Choose valid folders, input, fuel and 1–4096 runs.
message.itemexplorer.production_cancelle: Run cancelled. Items remain in the machine.
message.itemexplorer.production_unconfig: Configure and save this program file first.
message.itemexplorer.production_ready: Program ready; enter the run count and start.
message.itemexplorer.production_running: Machine processing; products will be collected automatically.
message.itemexplorer.production_complete: All operations in this run completed.
message.itemexplorer.production_disconne: No terminal connected. Check the outward data cable.
message.itemexplorer.production_unloaded: Paused: part of the network is not loaded.
message.itemexplorer.production_terminal: Connect exactly one storage terminal to this network.
message.itemexplorer.production_machine_: Machine interface offline or attached device unsupported.
Use only one machine interface per device.
message.itemexplorer.production_invalid_: Input or fuel entry changed; select it again.
The selected input and auxiliary item do not form a recipe for this machine.
Selected item is not valid fuel or a brewing reagent for this machine.
Paused: a bound folder no longer exists.
message.itemexplorer.production_terminal: Terminal replaced; cancel and save the configuration again.
message.itemexplorer.production_machine_: Machine replaced; cancel and save the configuration again.
message.itemexplorer.production_recipe_c: Recipe changed; cancel and save the configuration again.
message.itemexplorer.production_machine_: Empty all machine slots and let any existing operation finish before starting.
message.itemexplorer.production_interfer: Unexpected machine inventory; inspect it and cancel the task.
message.itemexplorer.production_output_f: Paused: output storage capacity or entry limit reached.
message.itemexplorer.production_containe: Paused: the fuel or supplies folder cannot accept the returned container.
message.itemexplorer.production_missing_: Waiting for input in the configured folder.
Waiting for fuel or reagent in the configured auxiliary folder.
gui.itemexplorer.program_configured: Configured. Open to choose a run count.
gui.itemexplorer.program_unconfigured: Open to select a machine and production folders.
gui.itemexplorer.program_tile_hint: Left-click to open; right-click to select for rename, delete, copy or move.
gui.itemexplorer.program_open_hint: Open this program to edit its settings or run it.
gui.itemexplorer.program_copy_hint: Copy this program into the current folder. The copy will not start automatically.
gui.itemexplorer.program_move_hint: Click, then choose a folder to move this program file.
gui.itemexplorer.program_delete_hint: Delete the selected program. Stop a running program first.
gui.itemexplorer.folder_rename_hint: Rename the current folder or disk.
gui.itemexplorer.production_back: Return to the terminal folder. Unsaved changes will be discarded.
gui.itemexplorer.production_machine_hint: Click to cycle machines; hold Shift to go back. Supports furnaces, blast furnaces, smokers and brewing stands. Programs belong to local terminal folders; ports execute them.
gui.itemexplorer.production_reagent_fold: Choose a brewing reagent here and keep blaze powder in the same folder for automatic refueling. Click to change folders; hold Shift to go back. Subfolders are excluded.
gui.itemexplorer.production_choose_potio: No base potions in this folder
gui.itemexplorer.production_choose_reage: No brewing reagents in this folder
gui.itemexplorer.production_brewing_coun: Run 1–4096 times. Each run uses one base potion and one reagent. Blaze powder is supplied automatically from the supplies folder.
message.itemexplorer.production_program_: Run identity changed. Inspect the machine and cancel the old task.
A terminal can store up to 32 program files.
message.itemexplorer.production_missing_: Waiting for plain blaze powder in the auxiliary folder.
message.itemexplorer.production_local_on: Program files are available in normal folders on the terminal local disk.
message.itemexplorer.production_legacy_s: Legacy interface task stopped. Items remain in the machine; create a program file in the terminal.
